subject: Revenue corridor lockdown + evidence pack for investor review
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Cc: Anjali Shah <anjali.shah@atlascap.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Revenue corridor lockdown + evidence pack for investor review

Team —

We have a compressed window to lock the revenue corridor for the investor stress review next week. High-level asks:

1) Stage hygiene: any opportunity >$50k must have updated stage + expected close date and the primary contract trigger (PO/SOW/POC). Use column "Close Trigger" in the workbook.
2) Commit audit: mark deals as "Commit" only if legal has received redlines and finance has a committed billing cadence.
3) Evidence pack: attach contract excerpts or SOC2 references for any mid-market > $200k.

I've attached a starter workbook (Q4_revenue_corridor_workbook.xlsx) and an evidence_pack_v1.zip that contains the current SOC2 artifact and a redline tracker. Please:
- Update workbook rows for your deals by EOD Thursday (10/08).
- Upload any new attachments to the Drive folder linked below.

I'll consolidate and send to Anjali (Atlas) Friday morning for the preliminary stress pass. If we can't substantiate a commit, we'll move it to "Best Case".

Thanks —
Lauren
VP, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Q4_revenue_corridor_workbook.xlsx (xlsx)
Attachment: evidence_pack_v1.zip (zip)
Link: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/Q4-readiness

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Anjali Shah <anjali.shah@atlascap.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Revenue corridor lockdown + evidence pack for investor review

Lauren —

Acknowledged. I'll run a quick pass on the top 12 deals (by ARR) and flag any that lack legal confirmation. Early notes: two enterprise deals in APAC have incomplete billing cadence and one needs KYC docs; I'm looping Marcus for the billing cadence verification.

I'll attach the stage-change-log once I finish (will include timestamped notes so we have an audit trail).

-Vivek
COO, Redwood Inference

Attachment: stage-change-log.csv (csv)

Adding quick billing notes for the top deals I own:
- RHD-459 (Acme Ops): finance confirmed monthly invoicing; legal awaiting signature (expected 10/12).
- RX-210 (Atlas PoC): PO received, but SOW dependencies still outstanding (expected 10/09).
- XN-77 (internal pilot): move to Best Case — no contractual trigger yet.

I'll push updates into the workbook this afternoon.

-Marcus

From: Anjali Shah <anjali.shah@atlascap.com>

Cc: Matt Green <matt.green@acme-ops.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 07:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Revenue corridor lockdown + evidence pack for investor review

Thanks, Lauren and team. A couple asks from the investor side before Friday's pass:

- Can you provide a one-page backup per "Commit" deal that lists the contract trigger, billing schedule, and any open legal items?
- For any deals where SOC2 or data residency is cited as a blocker, point to the exact artifact and version in the evidence pack.

We prefer the one-pagers in PDF in the shared Drive folder. If helpful, I can share a template.

Regards,
Anjali Shah
Principal, Atlas Capital

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Anjali Shah <anjali.shah@atlascap.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>

Thanks for the note. We used your one-pager template last quarter; I'll re-run it for the five Commit deals (RHD-459, RZ-302, TX-811, RX-210, ZA-05). Expect PDFs in the Drive by 10/09 10:00 PT.

Quick flags: RZ-302 has a pending pricing appendix that legal is reviewing (expected sign 10/11) — I'll mark the workbook to reflect this.

Neha

Folks —

Thank you for the quick turn. I pulled everything into a consolidated packet this morning and exported a short investor memo. Quick summary:
- Locked Commit corridor: $4.2M ARR (5 deals) — all have either signed triggers or finance-confirmed billing cadence.
- Best Case corridor (reasonable probability): $1.8M ARR — docs in Drive; several items flagged for legal.
- Items outstanding: RZ-302 appendix, APAC billing cadence for RX-210, KYC for XN-77.

I've uploaded: consolidated_packet_v1.pdf, investor_one_pagers (folder), and the locked-corridor-extract.csv to the Drive link. Anjali — sharing the link now for your preliminary stress pass.

Lauren
VP, Finance Operations
